data.description:
Spine task 3 of D1 v1, and the mechanism behind a standing company constraint rather than a feature. Build the single module through which EVERY Stripe API call in this product passes. It must: hard-require the Stripe-Account: acct_... header on every connected-account call; reject at the call site any request carrying transfer_data, on_behalf_of, or platform-side charge/invoice parameters; expose a transport seam so tests can substitute a fake; and ship tests that FAIL IF THE BAN IS REMOVED (assert the guard's refusals, not only the happy path).

IMPLEMENTS: docs/engineering/00-d1-v1-milestone-plan.md section 3 row C-03 (IN by mandate — board constraint 7 and assumption A3, milestone plan section 5). Section 8.3 spine task 3.

DECISION CONTEXT. This is not defensive-coding taste. docs/strategy/03-gate-verdicts.md constraint 7 says we are never a payee, never an aggregator, and never in the flow of funds. The D1 spike (docs/strategy/spikes/spike-D1-freelancer-invoicing.md section 1) MEASURED that the forbidden shape lives in the same API and that stripe-mock accepts it: a platform-side invoice with transfer_data[destination] is a perfectly valid Stripe call that silently makes us merchant of record and puts client money on our balance. The API will not hold this boundary for us. This module is how we hold it mechanically instead of by memory, and it lands BEFORE any code that calls Stripe — the only ordering under which the "permanent design-review obligation" the spike priced means anything.

Second reason for the chokepoint (assumption A2): the board has not ruled whether a Stripe application fee is clean under constraint 7 (docs/strategy/07-decision-memo.md section 4.2; docs/strategy/08-board-decision.md section 3.2 makes subscription-only the operative default). BUILD NO APPLICATION-FEE PATH — the constraint is honoured literally. Routing every call through one module is what makes a future board reversal one parameter on one call rather than a refactor. Declining to foreclose is not the same as building.

VERIFICATION: unit tests against the fake transport, plus request-shape validation against stripe-mock (MIT, free, no account — run it as a compose service from its public image; pulling a public image is not a signup and not a purchase). Tests must include negative cases: a call without Stripe-Account is refused; a call carrying transfer_data or on_behalf_of is refused; deleting the guard turns the suite red. Runnable now with no accounts.

NOT IN THIS TASK: any product endpoint or feature that uses the wrapper; webhook signature verification (that belongs to the webhook task, which has different inputs and a different failure mode); any real Stripe account or network call — none exists and none is assumed.
data.title: D1 v1: Stripe client wrapper with custody guard (never in the flow of funds)

data.note: spine: the guard lands inside the app, before any Stripe caller

data.body: Pulled as spine task 3: AS-37 (scaffold) is done and AS-53 closed the guard-coverage hole the custody chokepoint leans on, so the enforcement surface is now the whole image. Planning (Owen); implementer Marcus; review Priya. Three tasks depend on this one (Connect onboarding, invoice lifecycle, webhook receiver).

Plan written (10 sections). Decisions: hand-rolled client, not the SDK (stack decision §8.1 — new Stripe(key) is the documented bypass); BOTH an endpoint allowlist (9 rows) and a parameter denylist (10 names, each cited to the 2026-08-26.dahlia spec, checked as decoded bracket segments on the wire body/query) plus a hard-forbidden endpoint-prefix list the allowlist itself is checked against at module load; platform calls YES but exactly three onboarding endpoints (POST /v1/accounts, POST /v1/account_links, GET /v1/accounts/{id}), strict both ways; secret via INVOICING_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY from gitignored apps/invoicing/.env.local through a ${VAR:-} pass-through (app boots and suite passes with none); stripe-mock v0.203.0 as a compose service on an internal no-egress network with -strict-version-check, test service untouched; 9 code/compose mutations pre-written for QA. ~14 files/~1,380 lines — over the tripwires, kept whole with written justification and a pre-agreed split line (§7).

Implementation stage starting: Marcus takes the plan into .worktrees/AS-38 on feat/AS-38-stripe-custody-guard. Plan §8 default answers apply (no key-format validation, no retries, no boot-time client, contract wall time recorded at review). Split line in §7 is available if the cycle runs long; default is one task.

AS-38 implementation report (developer-marcus). Branch feat/AS-38-stripe-custody-guard in .worktrees/AS-38, 3 commits on top of master 055cf6c, worktree clean, 0 .lattice/ paths touched, not pushed, status untouched (orchestrator moves to review).

COMMITS (each green in Docker at its own HEAD)
- f13c67e AS-38: add Stripe client with custody guard and the offline suite — test 100/100/0/0
- a96843b AS-38: add the stripe-mock contract half of the suite — test 115/103/0/12, contract 115/115/0/0
- c02a87c AS-38: document the Stripe key path, the contract run and the guard — README only

FILES (14 changed, +1829/-83; all paths under apps/invoicing unless noted)
Added: lib/stripe/custody.js 168 | lib/stripe/client.js 235 | lib/stripe/transport.js 56 | test/stripe-client.test.js 680 (30 tests: C*, G*, T*) | test/stripe-mock.test.js 295 (12 tests K0-K11, self-skip without ASC_STRIPE_MOCK_URL)
Changed: lib/config.js 169 (stripeSecretKey null/[redacted], requireKey) | compose.yaml 108 (web env pass-through, stripe-mock + contract under profile tools, internal network) | README.md 234 | test/config.test.js 243 | test/dependency-policy.test.js 572 (3 sanctioned lines, per-file allowlists) | test/deploy-shape.test.js 388 | test/harness.test.js 97 (8 files) | /.dockerignore 28 (**/.env.local) | /.gitignore 10 (comment fix only)

SUITE RUNS at HEAD c02a87c, isolated project asc-invoicing-as38 (cardinality first)
- run --rm --build test: 8 files; 115 tests / 103 pass / 0 fail / 12 skipped; exit 0. The 12 skips are exactly the stripe-mock cases ("ASC_STRIPE_MOCK_URL not set — run the contract service").
- run --rm --build contract: 8 files; 115 / 115 / 0 / 0 skipped; exit 0. Mock ready after ~255-308 ms of polling; in-suite duration ~2.0 s.
- Contract wall time (plan Q5): 7871 ms at HEAD, 7967 ms at a96843b — both around the whole `docker compose run` with the mock image already pulled and the mock started by depends_on. The first-ever run, which included pulling stripe/stripe-mock:v0.203.0, was also ~8 s.
- V1 (-e ASC_SELFTEST_MUTATE=1 test): exit 1, exactly the one self-test failing (115/102/1/12).
- Host `node --test` is not authoritative (no node_modules on host: express/ejs import failures + a NODE_ENV assertion); Docker runs are the record.

ACs VERIFIED OUTSIDE THE SUITE
- AC 3 web without key: boot log ends `"stripeSecretKey":null`; /healthz 200.
- AC 4 web with --env-file (scratchpad file holding the README's placeholder value, deleted afterwards): log shows `"stripeSecretKey":"[redacted]"`, 0 occurrences of the value in logs or /healthz, /healthz 200. (/healthz includes the redacted config object — pre-existing AS-37 behavior, not changed.)
- AC 5: `git check-ignore -v apps/invoicing/.env.local` -> `.gitignore:10:*.env.local`; .dockerignore gained `**/.env.local`. No .env.local created anywhere.
- compose config --services -> web only; --profile tools -> web, test, stripe-mock, contract; resolved web env INVOICING_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: "" when unset.
- AC 34 grep over the diff: exactly the two allowed hits (README placeholder line; the fixed fake key constant in stripe-mock.test.js). No secret value anywhere, including this comment.
- stripe-mock.test.js throws at load if ASC_STRIPE_MOCK_URL's hostname ends in stripe.com (belt for "never in the flow of funds").

MUTATIONS (plan §6). Each one indivisible: backup, trap-restore on EXIT, applied-assert, Docker test run, tree proved clean (git diff --exit-code AND status --porcelain), rebuild + re-run clean = 115/103/0/12 exit 0 every time. All four pinned source lines match the recipes exactly (every perl mutation applied on the first try). Exact failing sets:
- M1 guard bypassed: predicted C2,C3,C4,C5,C6,C7 (6) -> EXACTLY those 6 (115/97/6/12). G1-G9 stayed green as the plan intends.
- M2 ban emptied: predicted G1,G7,C2,C3,C4,C7 (6) -> 7 (115/96/7/12): the 6 plus G9 'refusal errors carry a code and never the headers' (it provokes a banned_parameter refusal). Dependency-policy leak test stayed green (money regex still matched custody.js), as the plan allowed.
- M3 scope check removed: predicted G3,G4,G5,G6,C5 (5) -> 7 (115/96/7/12): plus G9 and C7 'no key', both of which exercise several refusal kinds including missing_account.
- M4 header dropped after the guard: predicted C9 (1) -> 2 (115/101/2/12): plus T1 'loopback listener byte-for-byte', which drives the real client to a loopback listener and asserts the wire headers.
- M5a fetch in routes/health.js: exactly 1, message `routes/health.js:25: fetch — not sanctioned` (115/102/1/12).
- M5b transport imported by routes/pages.js: exactly 1, `routes/pages.js:1: stripe transport import` (115/102/1/12).
- M6 sanctioned line reshaped (globalThis.fetch): exactly 2 as predicted — 'every sanctioned construct is present exactly where it is declared' + 'no app source or manifest outside test/ contains an outbound HTTP client' (115/101/2/12).
- M7 POST /v1/transfers allowlisted: exactly 2 file-level failures as predicted, test/stripe-client.test.js and test/stripe-mock.test.js, each with `CUSTODY: ALLOWED_ENDPOINTS row POST /v1/transfers matches forbidden prefix /v1/transfers — refusing to load`; 75/73/2/0 because the two files' 42 tests never ran. Fail-closed at import.
- P1 mock tag unpinned: exactly 'deploy-shape: stripe-mock is the pinned public image with no ports' (115/102/1/12).
- P2 mock network given egress: exactly 'deploy-shape: the stripe-mock network has no egress and web is not on it' (115/102/1/12).
Wider-than-predicted sets (M2 +G9; M3 +G9,+C7; M4 +T1) are legitimate second witnesses, not bugs — findings against the plan's table, recorded here for QA.

RECIPE FINDING FOR QA (matters when re-running cold): the plan's recipe backs up IN-TREE (`$F.as38bak`). My first M1 attempt did that and got a 7th failure — dependency-policy 'the scan examines exactly the files it is supposed to — source, manifests, and nothing unclassified' — because the closed-world scan (V2b) fails on any unclassified file under apps/invoicing; the backup IS such a file. This will add one extra failure to EVERY §6 recipe run verbatim. Fix used for all recorded runs: backup in the scratchpad (out of tree), otherwise the recipe unchanged; also `git status --porcelain` alongside `diff --exit-code` so a stray untracked file would fail TREE_CLEAN. I ran without DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 (default builder); results do not depend on the builder.

DEVIATIONS FROM THE PLAN (all small; none change the design)
1. Seventh custody code `unexpected_platform`: `platform: true` combined with `account` is a guard refusal (StripeCustodyError), not a TypeError — one error class + code for every refusal keeps G9 uniform.
2. validateCall refuses unknown call fields — a misspelled `account` would otherwise silently become a platform call; refusing is the fail-closed choice.
3. Load-time forbidden-prefix violation throws a plain Error (message above), not StripeCustodyError — there is no request to attach and the check runs before anything else exists.
4. transport.js throws plain Error with `.code` (timeout/network/redirect...); client.js wraps into StripeTransportError — avoids a circular import between transport and client.
5. StripeApiError copies Stripe's type/code/param/message and exposes `stripeMessage`; `.message` is `Stripe <status> <type>: <stripe message>`.
6. interpret() treats non-object JSON bodies as `invalid_json`.
7. One extra unit test: baseUrl validation.
8. T4 (transport connection failure) tests port 1 AND a real closed port, so it does not depend on the OS's ECONNREFUSED-vs-EACCES for port 1.
9. compose `web` has a comment block on the `${INVOICING_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY:-}` pass-through and `--env-file`.
10. deploy-shape: extra assertions (top-level networks keys; `image` absent on built services) and a BUILT helper constant.
11. K9: the plan expects the error to name the unknown parameter; stripe-mock's message is `Request validation error: validator ... failed: additional properties are not allowed` and names nothing. Pinned instead to `/^Stripe 400 invalid_request_error: /`, status 400, type, requestId req_123, zero key leakage, exactly 1 transport call. (This was the one red contract run; fixed before commit.)
12. K-tests use an observedTransport() wrapper (call count + last response) — needed for K10's header-echo assertion and K11's `calls === 0`.
13. K11 asserts `missing_account` first (no account), then `banned_parameter` with segment `transfer_data` (with account) — pins the endpoint -> scope -> params order on the wire test too. The mock accepts the forbidden shape raw (200, object invoice), so the client is the only thing refusing it.
14. K3 invoiceitems uses customer/description/quantity/metadata — no money field (a money literal in test/ would need a dependency-policy allowlist entry for no benefit).
15. K8 account_links includes refresh_url/return_url — required by the mock's OpenAPI spec.
16. Commit boundaries: the plan's three could not each be green (harness/dependency-policy/deploy-shape carry literal file/service counts that reference the contract half), so: offline half / contract half / README, each verified green.
17. Mutation backup out of tree (see recipe finding).

PLAN ITEMS THAT WERE WRONG OR STALE
- §6 predicted sets for M2/M3/M4 are narrower than the real detectors (above).
- §6 in-tree backup trips V2b (above).
- K9 wording assumption (above).
- test/health.test.js 'no secrets exist yet...' name is now stale wording; its assertion (no secret value in /healthz) still holds and passes. Left alone — out of scope, one-line rename for the next touch.

LEFT UNDONE / STATE OF THE MACHINE
- Nothing functional undone. Not done by design: no .env.local, no push, no status transition, no edits to the protected top-level files.
- Docker: `down --remove-orphans` done; 0 asc-invoicing-as38 containers/networks/images remain. Removed the 3 images the isolated project built and, by ID, the 28 dangling intermediates from my rebuilds (2026-09-01 19:44-19:57 EDT); the 144 older dangling images belong to other work and were not touched; no global prune. stripe/stripe-mock:v0.203.0 left pulled on purpose (the main checkout's contract run needs it; re-pulling is a network call). asc-invoicing-web-1 (8348) and asc-chat-server-1 (8347) never touched, both healthy.
- Run and mutation logs are in this session's scratchpad only (not committed).

To review: branch feat/AS-38-stripe-custody-guard at c02a87c (3 commits, 14 files, +1829/-83, no .lattice paths). QA reviews cold next tick against plan §5 (34 ACs) and re-runs §6 in the worktree with isolated compose project asc-invoicing-as38-qa.

The tasking message contained no counts, sets or verdict, so this derivation was blind. Comparison with the report is the final section.

SUITE RUNS (cardinality first), isolated project `asc-invoicing-as38-qa`, DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1, never the default project:
- `run --rm --build test`: 8 `*.test.js` files (node's `**/test/**/*.js` pattern also lists `test/helpers/server.js` as a 9th file-level entry — pre-existing, 0 tests, harmless); 115 tests / 103 pass / 0 fail / 12 skipped; exit 0; 3 s wall. - `-e ASC_SELFTEST_MUTATE=1 test` (V1): exit 1, exactly 'V1: the runner can fail — ASC_SELFTEST_MUTATE=1 must turn this suite red' (115/102/1/12).

PER-AC (plan §5; evidence = command or test, observed result):
1 PASS — test run above. 2 PASS — contract run above. 3 PASS — `up -d web` (ports overridden to 127.0.0.1:18348 via a compose override so the main checkout's 8348 was never touched; it stayed 200 throughout): boot log `"stripeSecretKey":null`, /healthz 200, `ps` shows only `web` (profiles keep test/stripe-mock/contract down); "not pulled" is only provable as "not started" because the mock image was already on this host before my session. 4 PASS — `--env-file` with the README placeholder: log `"stripeSecretKey":"[redacted]"`, /healthz 200, 0 occurrences of the value in logs or /healthz, `${#INVOICING_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY}`=9 inside the container, `/app/.env.local` absent from the image; env file deleted afterwards. 5 PASS — `git check-ignore -v` → `.gitignore:10:*.env.local`; `.dockerignore:28 **/.env.local`; no `.env.local` exists in the worktree; status stays clean with one present. 6–9 PASS — G1/G2/G7/G8 + C2/C3/C4 green; my probe (worktree modules imported directly, loopback listener only) refused every forbidden key at every nesting/encoding the plan names (`transfer_data[destination]`, `transfer_data%5Bdestination%5D`, dotted, query-string, uppercase, whitespace-padded) with `banned_parameter` and 0 transport calls. 10 PASS — `/v1/transfers`, `/v1/payouts`, `/v1/application_fees` + three off-list paths → `endpoint_not_allowed`, 0 calls. 11 PASS — G5/G6: `unexpected_account`, `platform_not_declared`; `platform:true` with an account → `unexpected_platform` (seventh code, see findings). 12 PASS — G4: `cus_123`, `acct_`, `ACCT_x`, `acct_x y` → `invalid_account_id`. 13 PASS — guard order endpoint → scope → params pinned by K11 on the wire and by G9's mixed cases. 14 PASS — C9 + T1: the listener sees exactly the guarded headers + `authorization`; `Stripe-Account` set once, value verbatim. 15 PASS — C7: refusals fire with no key configured (custody before `requireKey`). 16 PASS — C5/C6: clean call without a key → `ConfigError` "INVOICING_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: is not configured…", 0 transport calls. 17 PASS — T2: `redirect:'error'` — redirect refused, exactly 1 request seen. 18 PASS — C12/C13: key never appears in any error `message`/`detail`/`stack`; G9 refusals carry no headers. 19 PASS — C14: CRLF in an idempotency key is refused before the wire. 20 PASS — client.js exports exactly {StripeApiError, StripeCustodyError, StripeTransportError, createStripeClient, encodeForm}. 21 PASS — M7 below (fail-closed at import). 22 PASS — dependency-policy green with the wrapper present: `source.length === 14` and `SANCTIONED.length === 3` are asserted literals (test lines 374/506), not prose. 23 PASS — M5a/M5b messages are `file:line: construct — not sanctioned — <line> — remove it, or … add a SANCTIONED entry with a reason`. 24 PASS — X7a–f below (all six concept rows bite). 25 PASS — P1/P2/X9/X10/X5 below; `test` still `network_mode: none` (existing deploy-shape test green). 26 PASS — K11 green in the contract run; my raw probe from inside the contract container confirms the mock returns 200 to the forbidden shape, so the client is the only refusal. 27 PASS — K1 and K9 green; X8 below proves the version constant is load-bearing; the AC asks only that the mock reject an unknown parameter (400 observed), not that it name it. 28 PASS — C15 green in both runs. 29 PASS — all nine §6 recipes red as required, restored 115/103/0/12 each time. 30 PASS — largest source file test/stripe-client.test.js 680 lines (package-lock 898 is not source). 31 PASS — package.json/lock byte-identical to master; 0 new deps. 32 PASS — app.js, server.js, routes/*, lib/health.js, Dockerfile untouched; `.lattice/` absent from the diff. 33 PASS — README: the old "no `.env*` file" sentence is gone (0 hits); the three commands, `.env.local` key path, absence behaviour and the stripe-mock rationale are present. 34 PASS — grep for `(sk|rk)_(test|live)_[A-Za-z0-9]+|whsec_` over diff and worktree: exactly the README placeholder and the fixed fake `sk_test_stripemock` constant in the K tests.

§6 RECIPES — each one indivisible on a scratch copy (rsync of the worktree into the scratchpad; backup OUTSIDE apps/invoicing; trap-restore; mutation asserted applied by grep; run; restore; `diff -qr` scratch==worktree; rebuild + re-run clean). Exact failing sets vs the plan's prediction:

NEW CHECKERS BROKEN ONCE EACH (beyond §6; all restored and re-run green):
X1 `test` service with ASC_STRIPE_MOCK_URL set but no mock reachable → all 12 K tests FAIL (not skip) after the 10 s readiness poll (115/103/12/0) — the contract half cannot pass vacuously. X3 a 9th `*.test.js` → harness 'V2: the suite is exactly the files it is supposed to be' ("expected exactly 8 test files, found 9"). X4 config.js redaction mutated → 2: the config-test null/redacted pin + 'the health body carries redacted config, never raw config'. X5 literal credential value in compose web env → 'deploy-shape: no credential VALUE appears in compose.yaml, and every secret-shaped variable is a pass-through'. HOSTILE PROBES (worktree modules on host, loopback only; and raw POSTs to the mock from inside the contract container): 22 banned shapes refused, 0 transport calls.
